latest_release.name: vphone 2.18.0
latest_release.body:
## vphone 2.18.0

The changes merged since 2.17.1, the same as 2.17.2, released as the 2.18 series. Use Launchpad 2.18 with `VPhone.bundle` 2.18.x; the minimum bundle is unchanged.

**Core Bundle**

- `vphone-cli vm launch <name> --detach` starts a machine in its own session, writes its console to a per-machine log under `~/Library/Logs/vphone-launchpad`, and returns once the guest answers (`--timeout` bounds the wait). (#947)
- Pause and resume a running guest. (#970)
- Memory dumps: save the guest kernel's memory, one guest process's memory with each thread's registers, or all guest RAM from the host, in Diagnostics or the CLI. (#956, #957, #968)
- `vphone-cli vm ca install/remove/list` manages custom CA anchors in a guest's trust store. (#961, #973)
- Networking: an optional SOCKS5 server for NAT guests, and transparent SOCKS5 interception for tunnel-mode guests, with UDP associations. (#935, #954, #972)
- Kernelcache mixes are linked with the kmutil the base names, fetched from that macOS release when this Mac's differs; `fw kernelcache` no longer needs an ssh builder or root, and `fw kernelcache --kernelcache <file>` mixes without a VM. (#930)
- iOS 27: minimal 27.2 on its native kernel, the standard preset on a cloudOS 27.2 kernel, and minimal refused on a stock cloudOS 26 kernel. (#931, #940, #975)
- Trusted darwinOS and cryptexes across iOS 18 and iOS 27. (#932)
- iOS 17.7 App Library and stock wallpaper on iPhone SE 3 and iPhone 15; Safari page rendering and 2D Canvas on iOS 18; Astronomy on the SE 3. (#928, #929, #952)
- Four-way System Camera rotation (⌃⌘R). (#946)
- GLES framebuffer blit orientation on paravirtual Metal. (#950)
- Semantic accessibility input bound to the active app display. (#938)
- Developer Mode on minimal guests is the guest's own switch. (#955)
- vphoned: paged lists read in full on the host, a corroborated `screen.unlock` lock-state read, the effective UDID and build in `device.info`, and the proxy kept in the worker's jetsam band. (#936, #964, #971, #974)
- A symlinked cache directory is accepted; `vm template find` defaults the preset like `vm create`. (#949, #959)

**Launchpad**

- The ssh kernelcache builder fields are gone from New Machine. (#930)
- Machines are launched detached through the shared kit, and console logs move to the new naming. (#947)
- The helper appears under the app in Background Items, and says why it cannot open a library folder. Its build is 22, so Launchpad installs the helper again once when coming from 2.17.1 or earlier. (#943, #944)

**Upgrading**

Update the environment of an existing machine (`vphone-cli cfw update-environment`) to deploy the new vphoned and guest patches.

# vphone-cli Run a virtual iPhone on an Apple Silicon Mac. > [!WARNING] > This project has never issued or authorized any cryptocurrency or token, and does not accept cryptocurrency payments or donations. Any cryptocurrency or token issued or promoted in this project's name, or claiming any affiliation with it, is a scam. ![Virtual iPhone running on macOS](Documents/demo.jpeg) vphone-cli runs iOS with Apple's Virtualization.framework and PCC research virtual machines, for security research, reverse engineering, and debugging. ## Documentation Everything else lives on the documentation site: **** - [Quick Start](https://lakr233.github.io/vphone-cli/get-started/quick-start): requirements, host settings, and your first VM with Launchpad. - [Manual](https://lakr233.github.io/vphone-cli/get-started/overview): machines, firmware, storage, networking, and troubleshooting, in English, 中文, 日本語 and 한국어. - [Research Notes](https://lakr233.github.io/vphone-cli/research/): patches, boot chain, restore, and the automation API reference. The sources of the site are in [`Documents/`](Documents/) and [`Research/`](Research/). ## Let an Agent Install It If you use a coding agent (Claude Code, Codex, or similar) on this Mac, paste the prompt below instead of following the steps by hand. The agent reads the vphone skill, checks what is already set up, installs Launchpad and `VPhone.bundle`, and stops to ask when a step needs you, such as an administrator password or a change in macOS Recovery. ```text Set up vphone on this Mac. Read the skill at https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Lakr233/vphone-cli/main/Skills/vphone-guest-control/SKILL.md and the files it links under references/ (same folder), then follow them: install the newest notarized vphone-launchpad (not every release has a -notarized zip), put vphone-launchpad-cli on PATH, install the VPhone.bundle that matches Launchpad's series, and check `vphone-launchpad-cli status`. Do not change SIP, boot-args or any other host security setting, and do not create a machine until I confirm the firmware and the free disk space. When a step needs me, tell me exactly what to do and wait. ``` ## Acknowledgements - [wh1te4ever/super-tart-vphone-writeup](https://github.com/wh1te4ever/super-tart-vphone-writeup) - [owngoal-dev/OpenAVB](https://github.com/owngoal-dev/OpenAVB) and [owngoal-dev/OpenSEP](https://github.com/owngoal-dev/OpenSEP), the boot ROMs new VMs start from ## License vphone-cli is released under the [MIT License](LICENSE).
